meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会接入 GitHub,在 PR 和 issue 的评论线程里参与对话:有人 @ 机器人账号时回复;首次被 @ 后该线程自动订阅,后续评论也会回应。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 机器人的 GitHub 用户名时接管;首次 @ 之后该线程保持订阅,后续评论继续触发。

say.text: 这是公开仓库,用 strict 策略,只让已注册成员触发
say.note: 陌生人的评论不会触发 agent

say.text: 把用户 github:123456 加为成员,授权它触发 agent
say.note: 需要先拿到对方的数字 ID

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude joins GitHub PR and issue comment threads: it replies when someone @-mentions the bot account, and after the first mention the thread stays subscribed so it answers follow-up comments too.
howto.when_en: It takes over when someone @-mentions the bot's GitHub username in a PR or issue comment; after that first mention the thread stays subscribed and later comments keep triggering it.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel for repo github:acme/backend
say_en.note: It asks whether the repo is private or public

say_en.text: This is a public repo, use the strict policy so only members trigger
say_en.note: Strangers' comments won't reach the agent

say_en.text: Add user github:123456 as a member so they can trigger the agent
say_en.note: You need their numeric GitHub ID
